US Tech Outages Sparked Debate Over Cyberattack vs. Glitches

A series of major technology outages affecting Microsoft, Apple, major US banks, and air traffic control systems in the United States has led to public concern and debate over their causes. While some experts and politicians have raised alarms about potential cyberattacks, including theories linking them to AI, US Senator Marco Rubio stated there is "zero evidence" that the recent outages are related or malicious. Former SEC Chair Jay Clayton also commented that the events "are not a cyber attack." The incidents have intensified public paranoia regarding the reliability of technology.
